verdict.rationale: Appwrite docs explicitly document MFA implementation (appwrite-docs-4) and OAuth-based social logins (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-26), but no evidence of dedicated enterprise SSO protocols like SAML or OIDC identity-provider federation is present in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO documentation, admin-enforced MFA policy controls, and independent confirmation of enterprise SSO working in production.
